learning_notebooks.table:
CREATE TABLE learning_notebooks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_learning_notebooks UNIQUE (space_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

note_chapters.table:
CREATE TABLE note_chapters (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	node_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_note_chapters UNIQUE (space_id, node_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

note_revisions.table:
CREATE TABLE note_revisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	chapter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(chapter_id) REFERENCES note_chapters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

note_generations.table:
CREATE TABLE note_generations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	space_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	chapter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	context JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_note_generations UNIQUE (assessment_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(space_id) REFERENCES learning_spaces (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(chapter_id) REFERENCES note_chapters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
